report.title: Refuter role design: incentives, success metric, and measured yield versus finder agents
report.question_or_target: How should a refutation agent be scored so that producing zero refutations on sound work is a PASS rather than a failure, and what is the measured refutation yield (refutations per agent-hour, share that survive re-review) compared with finder agents on the same corpus?

answer.score: Pre-register every assigned claim. Require numeric p_invalid for each one, including no-finding claims. An independent all-claim oracle assigns y without seeing the forecast, role, or authorship. Headline score is 100 * mean(1 - (p_invalid - y)^2). Keep sound-control specificity and bad-control sensitivity as hard gates. Never reward output count (fan-out B7).
answer.zero_refutations_rule: Zero submitted refutations is a PASS when every assigned claim was forecast, the independent oracle labels them sound, the sound control stays clean, and a separate known-bad mutant proves sensitivity. Silence alone is not a PASS.

score_contract.unit_of_score: every assigned claim, including claims with no submitted refutation
score_contract.required_forecast: p_i in [0,1], probability that the claim is materially invalid
score_contract.oracle: independent all-claim adjudication with forecast, role, and authorship withheld
score_contract.outcome: y_i=1 for materially invalid/refuted, y_i=0 for surviving/sound
pass_gates: zero surviving refutations on a preverified sound control
two mechanically independent signals for every candidate
authorship-blinded re-review with original claim_text withheld
score_contract.yield_reporting: predeclared unique surviving defect mechanisms / trusted-runner agent-hours plus mechanism survival share; candidate-envelope counts are a sensitivity diagnostic and never a quota
